digraph write_scenario_item {

    workflow_source = "factories/mothership/workflows/scenario-writing/write_scenario_item.workflow-source.mjs"
    done [shape="Msquare" label="Done" recovery_sink_type="terminal"]
    normalize_structure [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="scenario.ensure_structure" label="Normalize scenario structure" output_format="json" outputs="scenario_domain,scenario_slug,scenario_md" action_payload="${scenario_payload}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    payload_gate [shape="diamond" label="Scenario payload valid?"]
    renormalize_structure [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="scenario.ensure_structure" label="Normalize repaired scenario structure" output_format="json" outputs="scenario_domain,scenario_slug,scenario_md" action_payload="${scenario_payload}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    repair_payload [class="scenario_author" benchmark_job_id="goal.write_scenario.write_repair" llm_path_id="mothership.write_scenario_item.repair_payload" prompt_version="2026-03-12.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.write_scenario" llm_model="openai/gpt-5.1-codex-mini" label="Repair scenario payload" output_key="scenario_payload" output_format="json" reasoning_effort="low" timeout="2m" prompt="Your previous scenario payload failed deterministic validation.\n\nOriginal scenario JSON:\n${scenario_payload}\n\nRepair instructions:\n${retry_prompt}\n\nReturn JSON only with scenario_domain, scenario_slug, and scenario_md." recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    repaired_payload_gate [shape="diamond" label="Repaired payload valid?"]
    save [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="scenario.save" label="Write scenario file" output_key="scenario_path" action_payload="${payload}" action_registry_root="${scenarios_root}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond" label="Start"]
    validate_payload [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="scenario.validate_payload" label="Validate scenario payload" output_format="json" outputs="ok,error,retry_prompt,scenario_domain,scenario_slug,scenario_md,payload" action_payload="${scenario_payload}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    validate_repaired_payload [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="scenario.validate_payload" label="Validate repaired scenario payload" output_format="json" outputs="ok,error,retry_prompt,scenario_domain,scenario_slug,scenario_md,payload" action_payload="${scenario_payload}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    write [class="scenario_author" benchmark_job_id="goal.write_scenario.write" llm_path_id="mothership.write_scenario_item.write" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.write_scenario" llm_model="openai/gpt-5.1-codex-mini" label="Write scenario" output_key="scenario_payload" output_format="json" outputs="scenario_domain,scenario_slug,scenario_md" reasoning_effort="low" timeout="2m" prompt="Load the globally installed scenario writing skill by reading ~/.claude/skills/scenario-writer/SKILL.md, then follow it precisely. If the scenario-format reference is unavailable, proceed anyway.\n\nWrite a concrete, durable AstroChicken scenario that captures a known high-value product or factory judgment pattern.\nDo not write minutia, tiny edge-case scenarios, or exhaustive regression catalogs.\nThe scenario should be valuable enough that a future judge would plausibly reuse it across multiple related changes.\n\nHard format requirements for scenario_md:\n- Include ALL six sections with exact level-2 headings:\n  - ## Context\n  - ## Preconditions\n  - ## Trigger\n  - ## Expected Behavior\n  - ## Assertions\n  - ## Edge Cases\n- Include at least one '- [ ]' checkbox assertion.\nScenario brief JSON:\n${scenario_brief}\n\nReturn JSON with fields scenario_domain, scenario_slug, and scenario_md (full SCENARIO.md content). Return JSON only."]
    save -> done
    start -> write -> normalize_structure -> validate_payload -> payload_gate
    payload_gate -> repair_payload [condition="ok!=true" label="repair"]
    payload_gate -> save [condition="ok=true" label="valid"]
    renormalize_structure -> validate_repaired_payload
    repair_payload -> renormalize_structure
    repaired_payload_gate -> done [condition="ok!=true" label="fail_closed"]
    repaired_payload_gate -> save [condition="ok=true" label="valid"]
    validate_repaired_payload -> repaired_payload_gate
}
